title: Pure Dracoslayer

allow.Wavering Eyes: Generic Pendulum Spell (the API files it under Magician): destroys both your Scales, which is what Luster Pendulum and Ignis Phoenix want, and searches a Pendulum.
allow.Beyond the Pendulum: Generic Pendulum Link-2 that searches a Pendulum Monster; the page opens with it.

summary: Dracoslayer Pendulums with generic Pendulum support and staples; the page's Superheavy Samurai, Majespecter and Odd-Eyes engines are left out. Wind Unicorn Parallel, the Dracoslayer, the newest card, is a Scale 2 that summons itself or a smaller Pendulum from your Pendulum Zone. Pendulum Summoned, it can't be targeted or destroyed by the opponent's effects and bounces one of their cards on either turn. Luster Pendulum destroys your other Scale to add a copy of it, so the face-up Extra Deck fills up for big Pendulum Summons. Majesty Pegasus searches the next Dracoslayer, and Ignis Phoenix replaces itself from the Deck as a Tuner when destroyed. Master Peace, Draco Face-Off and Forge of the True Dracos all need Dracoverlord cards, so they stay out. The page's end board also uses Baronne de Fleur, which is Forbidden in the TCG.

Scale 3: destroys a card in a Pendulum Zone.
Destroys both Scales to search a Pendulum and fill the Extra Deck.
